_comment: See tools/check-ts-mutation.py for why this exists and how it is gated.
_mutate_comment: BY EXCLUSION, not inclusion. This was a hand-maintained list of every
file, which meant a NEW source file was ungated by default and nothing
anywhere said so -- the gate would report a clean run over code it had
never looked at. Found 2026-08-09 adding client/src/join.ts, and it is
the same trap check:race was rewritten out of two days earlier: an
inclusion list is a promise to remember, and the failure mode is silent.
Adding a file to client/src now gates it; taking one OUT is a visible
line here that has to carry a reason, as main.ts's does.
